_comment: Per-block size constraints (pixels) for the character-sheet dock panels, plus the GM window's own blocks (gm_*). Keyed by block. Omit a bound (or set it to null/0) to leave it unconstrained: a missing minimum is 0, a missing maximum is unbounded. max_width pins a block so it can't be stretched horizontally; max_height pins it vertically. Setting min == max in a dimension fixes that dimension (non-resizable); abilities and resistances share one fixed 300x340 size that fits all of either block's content — the height is what the taller of the two (abilities, with its Attack row below the derived rule) needs, plus a little slack, so both stay the same size whatever a preset does to the row height. A block's min_width matters most for a block that starts in the pinned strip (dice): a row on the page is wide enough for any of these, but the strip is only as thick as the widest block in it asks for, so a min_width under the block's content width would clip it there. These are the baseline: the active theme's 'blocks' map overrides any bound, since how much room a block needs depends on the look's density.
